title: OwnedInstructionRow

id.description: An owned instruction's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, kept in lowercase.

title.description: An owned instruction's title: 1 to 120 characters once trimmed, no control or format (zero-width) characters other than white space; stored trimmed with white space collapsed. A run reads it as the instruction's heading.

body.description: An owned instruction's body: Markdown, at most 20000 characters, which a run reads under its title.

catalogueId.description: The catalogue entry it was copied from.

anyOf.description: The catalogue entry an owned instruction was copied from, and the version it holds.

origin.description: The catalogue entry it was copied from; null for one written here (Custom).

anyOf.description: Every account on the environment, those added later included.

items.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

anyOf.description: The accounts named, each once; an account removed since reaches nothing.

scope.description: The accounts an owned instruction reaches: all (every account, those added later included), or the account ids named, each once.

enabled.description: Whether runs are handed it; switched off it stays listed.

position.description: Its place in the list: runs are handed the instructions in ascending order of it, then of id.

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

label.description: An account's label: 1 to 200 characters on one line, with no space at either end; unique on its environment ignoring case, preset to the email the account signed in as.

kind.description: How an adapter delivers standing instructions to its provider: system-prompt-append (Claude), developer-instructions (Codex), prompt (a local model), or none.

maxCharacters.description: The most characters the channel carries; null when it has no cap.

channel.description: Its adapter's instruction channel: none is handed no standing instructions.

reason.description: Why its runs are handed no standing instructions; null while its adapter has an instruction channel.

items.description: An account of the environment, with its adapter's instruction channel and, without one, why its runs are handed no standing instructions.

accounts.description: The environment's accounts, in the account list's order.

description: An owned instruction as instructions.list rows it, with the environment's accounts.
